blocks.x: OEE +7.2 points across 14 plants — sensor fabric to scheduling decisions

A global automotive OEM: a Manufacturing & Industrial program run on the outcome-linked model with a blended Achala IT Solutions team. The name stays behind the NDA; the numbers are published with permission.
Legacy lines uninstrumented; OEE components estimated; changeover losses structurally accepted.
Quality escapes discovered at customer complaints; inspection by sampling. Flat plant networks left lines exposed to ransomware.

We retrofitted sensor fabric on live lines (OPC UA/Sparkplug with data contracts), deployed vision inspection closing loops into andon/MES, and gave planners a Swarm scheduling assistant proposing changeover-aware sequences. IEC 62443 zoning preceded instrumentation — security first, then telemetry, then decisions on Forge.

blocks.x: What the success is actually made of

items: edge processing put decisions where the data was born; the round trips disappeared from the process.
every automated action carried its policy version and its trail, which is why operations trusted the fleet by month three.
lineage and freshness were design constraints from week one, so the measurement never became the controversy.

blocks.x: If the global automotive OEM program reads like your own estate, the honest advice is: start with the baseline diagnostic, not with the build. The differences that matter only show up in measurement The engagement model here was build-transfer; the same pattern runs fixed-scope where the estate allows it.
